thread:
alex.r: Heads up — we have degraded throughput on bulk enablement flows (enterprise onboarding jobs) started around 10:03 UTC. A subset of tenants are seeing prolonged provisioning times and delayed finalization callbacks. Investigating, tagging SRE.
mira.k: Noted. Which customers are impacted? Any renewal-tier ones?
alex.r: Early sample: 4 high-touch pilots and 2 trial-to-paid accounts in EMEA. Seems correlated with large batched requests to the Hosted API (bulk tokenization + embeddings step).
sam.t: @sre-liz can you confirm whether this looks like a rate-limit/throttling policy or a downstream queue backpressure?
sre-liz: We're seeing spike in request concurrency to the embeddings workers ~10:02-10:10 UTC which caused autoscaler thrash and a backlog, resulting in 502s for short windows. Not classic RL; more like scale lag + cache churn. Fix in progress: pinning an extra pool and bumping max replicas. ETA 20m.
jordan.c: Thanks. CS prioritization: I'll pull list of affected accounts and risk tier now. 
cs-bot: [automated] 5 affected accounts identified: ACME-Corp, Nimbus Health, VegaRetail, PilgrimAI (pilot), TestaLabs (trial)
tom.p: I'll draft an initial customer-facing status note for immediate outreach. Need to confirm wording for pilots and renewal-risk accounts.
mira.k: For renewal-risk accounts, propose offering 2 weeks of complimentary Dedicated trial or a 10% credit if SLA affected. Need legal ok?
alex.r: Good idea. Legal already ok'd ad-hoc credits under minor incident policy. Confirm with finance for larger credits.
sam.t: Ops question — any risk of failed webhook retries causing duplicate resources? We should advise customers to hold off retrying provisioning until we confirm backlog cleared.
re-sre-liz: Good call. We'll add idempotency markers server-side for the next rollout to avoid duplicates; in the short term, ask customers to pause retries.
jordan.c: Draft outreach (short):
```
Hi {CustomerName},
We're contacting you because we detected a delay in the finalization of your onboarding process earlier today (starting ~10:03 UTC). This was caused by an internal scaling issue in our bulk processing pipeline which may have made the provisioning step take longer than expected.
Impact: delayed startup/finalization of provisioning for a small number of new tenants; no data loss.
What we're doing: increased capacity, added temporary pool, and monitoring until backlog clears.
ETA: we expect backlog cleared within ~30 minutes; we'll update if anything changes.
If your onboarding is still incomplete after 11:00 UTC, reply here or open a priority ticket and we will escalate.
Apologies for the disruption — we know timing matters for your rollout and we're prioritizing impacted accounts.
Best,
The Redwood CS Team
```
tom.p: I tweaked language for pilots/renewal folks — added the offer line for credits/dedicated trial: include separate paragraph offering a credit and a scheduled 1:1 enablement session.
mira.k: Assigning outreach: @jordan.c to contact ACME-Corp and PilgrimAI (pilot), @tom.p to contact Nimbus Health and VegaRetail, @alex.r to chase TestaLabs trial owner. Please use the template and append the offer where applicable.
sam.t: Is there a canonical support ticket template to capture the incident label and expected remediation ETA? We should track these for renewal conversations.
cs-bot: [automated] Created ticket RED-INC-20247, assigned to cs-ops. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-INC-20247
jordan.c: Reached out to ACME-Corp — they replied: "Thanks, please confirm when nodes recovered — pilot kickoff depends on this." I offered a dedicated 30-min enablement slot and the credit pre-approval.
sre-liz: Autoscaler stabilization completed at ~10:22 UTC, backlog draining. We're seeing success rate return to baseline ~10:28 UTC. Continuing to monitor 30m.
alex.r: Update for the thread — 4 of 5 impacted accounts now finished onboarding; TestaLabs still in retry loop. Sam/Tom coordinate with SRE to force a retry window or manual finalize.
tom.p: I manually finalized TestaLabs provisioning at 10:35 UTC after coordination with SRE. Confirmed no duplicate resources. Customer notified.
mira.k: Will schedule renewal mitigation outreach for the higher-risk accounts — quick exec note + credit offer + enablement slot. Jordan/Tom, can you capture customer responses in RED-INC-20247 ticket?
jordan.c: Done, adding responses and follow-ups to the ticket. Also capturing NPS-impact question in the thread for later.
sam.t: Postmortem action items: 1) add short-term guardrail to pause autoscaler thrash; 2) improve idempotency on provisioning APIs; 3) create CS playbook for bulk onboarding delays (template + credit guidelines). Assigning owners: ops/alex.r, eng-mira.k, cs-jordan.c.
alex.r: Agree. I'll add owners and due dates in the ticket.
cs-bot: [automated] Incident RED-INC-20247 status -> mitigated at 2471123500, monitoring ongoing.
mira.k: Closing note for thread: please use the finalized customer template below when posting to accounts and include the credit offer specifics if they hit a milestone within 30 days.
```
Final customer message (use per-account customization):
Hi {CustomerName},
Update: The provisioning delay you experienced earlier today was caused by a temporary scaling issue in our bulk processing pipeline. The root cause was autoscaler instability under a sharp concurrency spike.
Impact: short delays in tenant finalization for a small number of customers. No data loss or security exposure.
What we did: pinned additional capacity, stabilized autoscaling, and added server-side idempotency to prevent duplicates.
Next steps: We're executing three follow-ups — autoscaler guardrails, idempotency rollout, and a CS playbook for faster comms.
Compensation: Because we know this affects rollout momentum, we'd like to offer {compensation_offer} (e.g., 2-week Dedicated trial or a one-time account credit).
If you have any concerns or want a 1:1 walkthrough, reply to this message and we'll schedule immediately.
Thanks for your patience,
The Redwood CS Team
```
mira.k: Thanks team. I'll bundle this into the customer pack and prep the renewal-risk brief for Execs. If anyone sees a lingering issue ping here.
alex.r: Great work — closing thread once ticket has final notes. Thanks everyone.
cs-bot: [automated] Thread closed by mira.k at 2471123600
